description: PK Kunhalikutty of the IUML retained the Industries and IT portfolios, which he had held during the previous Oommen Chandy Cabinet.
body_lead: Synopsis: Chief Minister VD Satheesan has taken charge of key ministries such as Finance and Law, while Ramesh Chennithala has retained Home and Vigilance. Another senior leader, K Muraleedharan, will be in charge of the Health and Devaswom departments. Meanwhile, the new Cabinet has a minister of Artificial Intelligence also. The Kerala government has announced the distribution of portfolios on Wednesday, 20 May. The portfolios included Artificial Intelligence, which went to PK Kunhalikutty.
